relationship_to_sibling: frozen-head control arm; V2.2 keeps selected LM-head rows trainable and V2.3 does not, so the pair isolates whether output-row capacity is required at all

architecture.lm_head_role: frozen answer-contrast reference and retain readout only

answer_contrast_direction.justification: with a frozen head the trained margin is exactly h . (W_new - W_true); the softmax normalizer cancels in the difference
answer_contrast_direction.multi_token_note: position i is read at the teacher-forced target_true prefix, matching the reported margin rule

row_partition_diagnostic.absolute_potential_floor_rule: relative floor times the strongest row potential
row_partition_diagnostic.free_rule: no retain observation after targeted per-row corpus coverage
row_partition_diagnostic.projected_rule: retain-observed row kept orthogonal to its own retain readout subspace
row_partition_diagnostic.excluded_rule: near-parallel, negligible cap-adjusted potential, or beyond the frequency bound
row_partition_diagnostic.empty_basis_semantics: unobserved by the registered retain bank, not proven unused

optimization.surgical_status: disabled in the primary arm; enabled only as a separately registered ablation
optimization.input_step_cap_justification: twice the V2.2 fraction because a single endpoint carries the whole step and projection removes part of it
optimization.step_order: gradient step, role projection, row cap, then forward-evaluated acceptance

central_claim: Static input-embedding edits achieve context-selective behavioral forgetting when the forget gradient retains a usable component outside the retained functional subspace, and the (efficacy, potential) partition diagnostic predicts when common subwords permit or prevent locality.

claim_boundary.latent_knowledge_erasure: out of scope while the Transformer is frozen
claim_boundary.alias_rule: a prompt containing none of the edited token ids produces exactly Base behavior; alias coverage requires a training-safe alias lexicon registered before the run
claim_boundary.projection_guarantee: local to the represented retain subspace, as in Orthogonal Gradient Descent (arXiv:1910.07104); exact linear erasure guarantees such as LEACE (arXiv:2306.03819) are not extrapolated through the nonlinear Transformer
